clanless.note: Self-made: clanless players start with +10 stamina and +5 control, learn one lesser technique per friendly clan (clan friendship 7) and every open style, so clanless is never the weaker pick.

player_clan_arts.how: A player clan's clan art is a technique its founder has mastered (ROADMAP Player clans); members learn it from the founder
player_clan_arts.allowed: any technique of rank C to A the founder has at mastered or better, not a kekkei genkai and not a clan's tier technique
player_clan_arts.bonus: the clan art costs its members 15% less
